about: Where each club of the earlier seasons' country maps stands, by country and the name its season gives it, written by node scripts/build-season-countries.mjs --homes (scripts/lib/season-club-homes.mjs): home [lon, lat] from a hand override (source "override", scripts/data/season-club-locations.json), the same club on today's map of its country (source "map:<its id there>", also its twin), the Europe maps' clubs (source "europe:<id>"), Wikidata (source "wikidata:Q…", CC0) or GeoNames (source "geonames:<id>", CC BY 4.0). null: none of them places it, and the map starts it at a populous place no other club stands in, an estimate.
